items.description: GlobAround is a desktop mashup that uses the APIs from Booli and Nestoria. It lets users search classified ads for free items from around the world. There are also sections for job listings and real estate.
The new intelligent property search engine for London. This tool uses Zoopla to aggregate and display search results.

The app allows users to search for rental apartments and houses right on Facebook. A combination of Google Map and Facebook API mashup allows users to search for rentals, share postings with friends, message them or simply chat to ask for opinion.
Uses Walk Score and Facebook Graph APIs and posts scores from any city to your Facebook wall.
Unlock knowledge of the local market and gain an edge when buying or selling real estate. Answers are provided by local real estate agents eager to represent you in a transaction.
A WordPress Plugin that conveniently displays an agent's AgentRank data- profile, sales, reviews, forecasts, etc., from RealtyBaron.

SchoolAndHousing offers school-centered online real estate searches. Search school by API test scores, region, zip code, city, county or address. Users can also search elementary, middle and high school overlapped attendance areas. Search detailed school information including test scores, demographic information, etc. and cross-reference with a local housing search.

Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
This real estate plug-in allows you to join a network of real estate web blogs who are growing their traffic through real estate Q&A.
A free site-building service that takes data from APIs and other content sources as a way for niche publishers to quickly create content-rich sites along with built-in monetization options.

View real estate information on every home around you as you move using the free Zillow iPhone App. Walk or drive through a neighborhood and see Zestimate home values, homes for sale, recently sold homes, and more.
See local area information for major us cities. See the age distribution in my city, the price per square foot, and other data. Find out by looking at this widget displaying data from Zillow.com.
Search for homes, get estimates for homes using Zillow, and find lenders for financing your home purchase.
This Facebook app allows you to connect to Zillow from Facebook. View information about your house and see what your friends houses are worth.
Property search engine for Spain of property data.
Community networking site that allows members to get in touch with their neighbours. The site uses APIs from Nestoria, flickr, Eventful and more to provide local information to users.

Mashup showing locations of 200 places mentioned in the Bible. Going for accuracy they try to pinpoint the locations of the ruins of ancient cities instead of using the locations of modern cities with ancient names.
Rules of thumb in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting rule of thumb from business, real estate, finance, fashion, sports, and more.
CryptoCRIT is an open-source Cryptocurrency project which facilitates a Cryptocurrency wallet for making payments. The associated Cryptocurrency is called CritCoin.

Cardinal Maps is an online mapping company that focuses on creating maps for commercial distribution and marketing purposes. Some of the maps that Cardinal Maps create include tourism maps, events maps, bike maps, and business maps.
Takes data submitted with a Formstack form and creates corresponding event entries on a Google Calendar.
A massively multi-player online crossword puzzle that happens in real-time via Pusher API. Built in 48 hours for a Node.js competition.
Route Scanner automatically works out relevant traffic incidents which could affect your journey and displays them on an interactive map. It uses RSS feeds from the BBC and Highways Agency. UK Only.
Travel Information Directory. Mashup of Naver and Flickr.
Allows Box.net users to send documents from their Box.net account to FedEx, where they can be printed and shipped.
Free walking route descriptions with OS Landranger mapping for each walk through Multimap API. Click on View next to buy map on any route to see the Multimap API page.

CanyonRunner is a 2D side-scroller HTML5 game that works on desktop and mobile, features a story and all the basic game systems you'd expect such as a progress saving system, top scores, different game dynamics on each level and two different endings. This application uses Ludei Cloud API.

3D driving simulator that shows the present position in different views including street and birds-eye view. Sightseeing tours are predefined for e.g. New York, Rome, Hollywood and Yellowstone Park. Views are synchronized for easy panning.
Advanced Reporting and analytics for Basecamp. bcToolkit provides management overview reporting for Basecamp projects and time tracking.
A community mashup where parents can create, review, tag, and map fun places to take their family.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.

The visual trace route tool displays the path Internet packets traverse to reach a specified destination on a Google Map. The estimated geophysical location of each hop is identified using the MaxMind GeoIP database.

eSignature Gateway leverages Amazon S3, Clockwork SMS, DocuSign, Google Storage and Twillio APIs to give users document sign functionality regardless of the email client used. In addition, eSignature implements electronic storage, data analytics and workflow capabilities.
Downloads all your followers from Twitter and displays the five oldest based on the date that the user began following you.

Veracity Media is a social marketing company that specializes in web design and development, social organization, and audience engagement and analytics. Veracity Media helps political campaigns, organizations, and individuals to inform, inspire, and engage their community with their campaigns/causes.
bookfriend is an Android application which creates companion guides for any book instantly and seamlessly wherever you are.

A Google Maps mashup of latest GeoTagged YouTube videos tagged with keywords World Cup Soccer and with a category of News or Sports. The Information window for each YouTube video lists location along with address and description of the video.
SharedBook used its API and Google widgets to build Blog2Print, a new blog printing widget that can be used by writers and their readers to turn blog posts into books.
Real-time tweet tracking for keywords across the world on a map. Currently tracks 250 countries and plans are to track all the major cities of the world.
Select any section of a webpage in Firefox and find related scientific and research papers. A resource for any scientist, literary writer or researcher in any field.
Displays Portland TriMet MAX light rail lines and stations on Google Maps.
A retail experience combining the API networks of Amazon, Twitter and YouTube with a plan to expand into further APIs to add increased syndication of data and media.
50 random World Heritage Sites on a Google Map. Each time you reload it shows another 50 random sites. With embedded photos and links to details on each site.
Think College is expensive then check out these preschools where tuition starts at 30,000 dollars US.
Map of hotels in Dublin.
Use this interactive map to find Boots Optician stores in the UK.
Mashup of job postings, interview questions and answers for easy job search and preparation.
Find wild creatures for EA Spore using this Google gadget for asset search views.
Simple and intuitive search tool, allows displaying photo time and date taken in either a radial or standard X,Y axis plot.

A social network to share photos. It collects automatically all your photos and contacts from Facebook, Flickr and Picasa and allows you to share your photos with your friends whatever their website is.

Improve your movie experience with the Moviis android application. Film information, trakt.tv integration, check-in, recommendations, history, watchlist, collection, lists, upcoming and now playing in theaters, ratings, trailers and much more...
Mashup to search bed and breakfasts in Italy on Google Maps. Customized clustering based on province, with icons indicating the number of actual markers.
The ten fastest elevators in the world from some of the tallest buildings in the world. Integrates YouTube videos of the buildings.
Map of all property values across Franklin county.
Mashes Google Maps with open data from Factual to show restaurants and their health code ratings. Code available on GitHub.
Amazon shopping meets YouTube to bring product trailers and videos mashed up with Amazon product content.
Did you know that 64% of the readers of Dan Brown's latest novel are male. Bookhu, the Gender Compatibility Engine for books, helps you find suitable books based on your gender.
smugmug photos overlaid on top of Google Maps.
Pingram allows users to search through Instagram photos using a Pinterest like interface.
This plugin allows you to validate form fields values populated in Wordpress sites against the uProc service, getting data when the form is submitted.

This tool helps residents of New York City find evacuation areas in the event of a hurricane. The Google Maps based tool is designed to prevent confusion like what was witnessed during Hurricane Sandy.
Send visual voicemail to any Twitter user with Pockets App and Twilio.

Is it possible to subscribe to a newsletter in as little as one click? I say yes. Mailchimp users can now embed this widget onto their site to federate list signups using Oauth as well as the traditional signup form.
WalkJogRun.net is a very good route planner and a distance-speed calculator for runners, joggers and walkers. See runs that others have outlined or create your own.
Internet application helps users create Google Maps with customized points of interest without writing code.

Music Updated helps you stay up to date with the music you like. It's like a twitter newsfeed, but dedicated to music news and upcoming albums based on the artists you follow. It acquires some of this information by leveraging the Last.fm and YouTube APIs.
Get all your special baby products from bol.com.
Notify is a note-taking application for the iPad, and through its integration with Box.net, users can upload their notes directly to a Box account.
Enter your zip code to find Social Security offices nearest you.
Produced with a time constraint of 5 days. The site is designed to provide reliable and concise information about Acid Reflux. It uses multiple APIs to pull in content about this condition.
Mashup of Google maps, Amazon and Stuffopolis. Here is a snapshot of where my stuff is around the world right now. Each marker is a friend. Click on a marker and you see what stuff they have.
Comprehensive map of UK schools with comparisons of student scores and search capabilities. Marker drill-down brings you to Dept of Education and Skills site details.
Bookmark all your favourite videos,sightseeing,pictures on a world map.
Tracks leads using a unique telephone number so that customers can be tracked when calling instead of just when they enter information into a website.

Notwilfications is a Google Chrome Extension that shows you when a call comes in and allows you to either ignore it or send it to voicemail, without ever having to pick up your phone to know who's calling.

MyApartmentMap is an apartment search engine that allows users to find apartment listings all over the United States. Searchers can view pictures, maps, rental data, find deals, post rentals and contact property owners. MyApartmentMap also has specific search features for college students, pet owners, and military families.
Get news, ratings, game schedules and rumors for NBA teams plotted on a map.
TextListen is a mobile music service. Just text the artist and name of a song you want to hear. The service will call you back and play the song for you on the speaker.
As you type a location, Google Maps Instant centers a map on the best result that is returned from Google's geocoder. The tool is surprisingly good at determining cities based on partial input.
Golf course and hotel locator for Myrtle Beach. Good coverage of the area. Warning: loads slowly.
Kijiji is a group of local, community-based classifieds websites.
Music Codex allows you to create a music collection virtual shelf.
Bikewatch aggregates and displays the current location and location history of rental bikes in Munich. It also shows the recent trips taken by bike riders.
A small Google Maps Mashup displays the weather forecast and weather-tweets in a nice, simple style.

MagTrack is a mobile app for Magento store owners. Use MagTrack's Android app to track sales data in real time, and receive push notifications about sales activity. The app tracks information like total sales, bestsellers, and order and customer details.
A mashup that produces output showing the @reply tweets you're no longer seeing in your Twitter stream (since #fixreplies) because you don't follow the person the message is directed to.
Google maps creation tool reminiscent of simple image-editing programs. Nicely done.
A social geomapped directory of more than 5.000 points of interest. Anyone is allowed to add, remove, move or rename markers.
Beer Signal is an iPhone application that helps bring friends together to enjoy good beer. Powered by Taplister.com, the app also uses the social networks Twitter and Shizzow.
ShutterPoint Image Upload API Demo mashup is based on their API and shows a sample HTML form to interact with the API.
CrocTail provides an interface for browsing information parsed from SEC filings about several hundred thousand U.S. publicly traded corporations and their foreign subsidiaries.

A Google map based interactive guide to the Bournemouth, Dorset, UK area. The map shows attractions, food outlets, pubs, and clubs. Routes mode lets you plot journeys and calculate distances. History mode displays a map of old local photos.
Translightor is a Silverlight mash-up using the Google Translator API. Source code available.
Map of all property values across the county.
Store your GPS tracks in the web server and view your private and everyone public tracks on Google Maps. Supports GPX format.
A mashup site where you can leave your digital footprints that are of emotional value to you. You can post photos and videos by form upload, email or MMS.
A tool for reverse IP lookup. This site's language is Turkish.

Real-time geographic visualization for emerging Twitter trends. By analyzing over 5 million tweets per day to visualize trending topics on a global, regional and city level, it identifying news as it happens and tracking its impact around the world.
Check how good automated translations are. Enter a sentence and choose a language. The sentence is translated into the choosen language and afterwards retranslated back into the origin language.
Indeed job search integrated with Facebook and LinkedIn - find jobs close to friends, and see who you know (or contacts know) at those offering the job.
This Google Maps Mashup maps out the latest GeoTagged YouTube videos which are tagged with Egypt Protests.
Organise your hen night or bachelorette party with free invitations, add Google map route-planning and directions, and create photo albums with pictures from your computer or mobile phone.
The True Knowledge Firefox add-on enhances your search engine results by inserting a direct answer to your question above your regular search results.

This web site integrates the popular Joomla CMS framework with a Google Maps API integration, to facilitate both geographic search, proximity search, directory search. The aim is to bring the inventory of apartments more easily to the attention of the visitor, and to make it easier for our visitors to find what they are looking for. The directory structure relies on a popular Joomla directory product called K2.
This tool calculates the total value of items in your Etsy shop, and presents a few other statistics too.
A continuous stream of videos from YouTube by (or related to) the rock band, The Decemberists.
Printr provided a fully featured 3D printing api that allows developers to create and connect all types of applications to 3D printing and directly to 3D printers.
Interactive Maps for the Louisville Metro area - crimes, sex offenders, historic sites, traffic cams, restaurant health ratings, homes for sale.

Lose It! is a mobile application related to weight loss available on Google Play and Apple iTunes. Besides identity, location, media, and camera, the app also needs access to In-app purchases. Once installed, the app asks for user weight, followed by goal weight, gender, height, and weight plan.
Nice search and visualization tool that lets you surf Flickr's tag space. Flickr tags are keywords used to classify images. Related tags shown based on clustered usage analysis.

The website historicplaces.net was created in 2012 as a comprehensive listing of buildings, structures, objects, and sites in North America that have received a special status based on their historical or archaeological significance. We have almost 100.000 historic places listed in our database.
The top 25 American cities with population greater than 250,000 ranked by percentage of bachelor degree holders among residents 25 years and older.

BanksNearMe is built with Google Maps API and the Google Places API and can be integrated with Bootstrap's mobile-first framework to help you find nearby banks and ATMs based on your current location, or by custom search. BanksNearMe is a free service.
A fun method to learn and improve your foreign languages like English, French or Italian through music and typing-in song lyrics.
Share Twitter feeds with the person you're talking to on the phone.
Best movies in theaters, coming soon or on dvd. Search movies, find movie times for theaters.
Largest University crime map mashup, covering over 200 universities.
The quick and easy way to make Google Maps. There is also a pro version with more functionality.
A Wordpress plugin that pushes updates to Taglets.org when you publish a post.
Filters tweets of a specified Twitter account and sends them by email to specified email addresses.
Map of Bastille Day Event Locations in the United States.

Compare your musical interests with your last.fm friends and neighbors. See what's similar between you and your friends as well as what's different; and in the process discover music or artists that you never knew you loved!

Real-time data pulled from Indeed. It can Produces Flexible RSS feeds for user's search query, and users can be more easy to subscribe with their favorite RSS Reader. Relevant career and job books from amazon API as value to user job search experienc
Using the PopShop API, FusionBoutique is a dynamic deals and offers portal for a wide range of products and services.
Compare LCD TV prices. The product and price data feed is pulled from the Shopping.com API.

Citizens can request service and check the status of service requests using Google Maps, Cityworks local API and ReCaptcha. Citizens can solicit a request by entering an address manually or select a location from a Google Map.
The Pinguinale 2006 is an event in Wuppertal, Germany, because of the 125 birthday of the Wuppertaler Zoo. Map shows the places of 200 pinguins and photos of them. Firefox works better.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Property site for landlords, property owners, managers, buyers, and tenants in Calgary and the surrounding area. Filter according to your preferences, such as close to a university.
The lyrics instant search engine
FIFA, World Cup Soccer 2006 map. Latest team news via Yahoo FIFA 2006 World Cup Soccer RSS feeds and Goolge News feeds.

Ten Word Moo Card takes the best rated reviews from The Ten Word Review, a site where you can review anything you like as long as you do it in exactly ten words, and creates Moo cards from them. Winner of the Moo API contest 2008.

A realtime classifieds service. Receive text alerts for job and business opportunities that are submitted by other users of the service. To respond, reply call by text message, and a call will be placed between the two parties.
Create your own Google Maps with photos, comments, directions.
Capture your memories from popular social media sites. See, search and share your photos, music, video, status updates, blog posts and more.
Wide collection of Arabic media including TV, radio, movies and clips.
Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.
Graph your Twitter stats, including Tweets per hour, Tweets per month, and Tweet timeline.

Developers can use this this mashup to insert a Giphy search bot into their HipChat sessions. Whenever a user types /giphy plus a keyword, the Lucille HipChat Bot will return a Gif that matches the search criteria. Requirements for implementation include the Python HipChat Library.
Android app which allows users to search for adoptable pets in the United States using the Petfinder API.
The BP Gulf oil spill - via an underwater view in Google Earth (approximate location).
lokerja.com is an Indonesian Job Listing aggregate. Using Indeed, this site pulls job listings sorted by location and reposts them on their own site.
You select your desired locations, such as all of the cities you have lived in, then the map will display all of your cities along with the exact midpoint for those places.
Gramfeed is an Instagram web client.
An AJAX-powered Twitter client that allows for logging in to multiple accounts simultaneously. Hashtags displayed in ComboTweet are automatically linked into Tagalus.
This browser based geography quiz uses Google Maps to present a blind map, where the user has to find a given location.
Enabling record labels to offer previews to artist fan clubs months in advance of releases, driving up pre-sales.
List of webcams in Czech republic.
FuhshniZZle is a music streaming mashup that pulls content from Youtube and allows users to search and play their favorite music, without interruption.
TheInterviewr lets media workers (journalists, bloggers, etc.) schedule and prepare for interviews. Interviews are conducted using Twilio's calling functions.
Yellow pages for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
A real estate site for the Greek market.
This tool uses Foursquare to allow users to rate public restrooms.
The app lets you create an illustrated version of your Foursquare neighborhood, building a visual game on top of FourSquareâ€™s existing technology.
A fun way to explore Flickr images based on your own taste. Select a couple of images you like and instantly get recommendations, based on like-minded people.
A Google Earth mashup that shows book tours happening around the world.
Visitors can add information about prices available in offline shops.
Make your own directions with Route Builder. Begin by navigating to the start of your route, click a point to start, the click others to get total distance.

Record phone calls by routing them through MyPhoneTap. Pay 15 cents per minute and receive your phone call as an MP3. You get two free minutes to try it out. Where it's the law, the system notifies callers that the call is being recorded.
Online Alternative Trading System (ATS) with Paypal Express Checkout API. Available on sourceforge.
Alternative interface to Amazon. Primarily via Amazon AWS, also incorporates del.icio.us, GMail, DropCash, Blogger and a library lookup.
Search Amazon by keyword, category, percentage off, price range, and eligibility for Prime or Super Saver Shipping. Sort results by bestsellers, featured, price, alphabetically or by customer review.
Plot, save and share running routes.

jiffr is a picture based dating service that works without words. You introduce yourself without words, only using the language of your flickr pictures and so you get a date without words. This is a free service.
WebCottages is a directory of self catering holiday cottages and other self catering holiday accommodation from around the UK.
Spying on FriendFeed public timeline in real time and more.
Just three steps allow you to ind where to recycle almost any product. Google Maps API with Ajax make it easy. The site has a search as you type feature and resizeable screen width.
This visualization reduces each word from the ESV Bible to a single pixel. Each line is one sentence. The line turns 90 degrees to the right after every sentence. Colors indicate metadata.
View a map that uses custom map types to create a 3D stylized map of Hong Kong.

TweepsMap analyzes where your Twitter followers are from, groups them by country, state or city and plots them on a Google map. Visualize data as a list or pie chart and share your reports with followers.
A community-style Google Maps mashup that lets location evangelists own their favorite places in virtual terms, showcase them, share their thoughts and shape the discussion.
Easy way to listen music.
Particle Reviews leverages the Rotten tomatoes API and Hulu's unofficial API to provide movie ratings on its site.
Park reviews for national and state parks. Includes option to mark favorite places to share with others.
Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.
Interactive map to see where the many Madoff pyramid scheme victims live.
You.travel features a cool interactive full-screen map along with travel guides to over 16,000 destinations, traveler reviews, and over 10,000 photos.
Keep to your kosher diet with this handy Google Maps mashup.
Outlet Note is a great place to find information about outlet stores in the United States. Google Maps (including Directions and Street View) are used to help you better locate a outlet store.
The GermTrax Mashup allows tracking the spread of sickness and disease via real-time symptom reports from around the world.

Converts between all major currencies using the latest exchange rates, including United States Dollar (USD), Euro (EUR), Japanese Yen (JPY), Chinese Yuan (CNY), British Pound (GBP), Canadian Dollar (CAD), Australian Dollar (AUD) and more.

Fongo provides a free phone call and SMS platform to residents of Canada by leveraging inexpensive WiFi/4G/3G data networks. Much of the information needed to make this a free service comes from the Yellow API data.
Kids today won't know the shrill cry of a 9600 baud or the magical doodleeedoo of a 28.8 modem. Preserve a little slice of history by recording and publishing your best dialup modem impression.
ShopAbout.co.uk is a comparison shopping site based on the Shopping.com API. Search and shop items by category.
A mashup for rating photos on Flickr.

This We Know lets you get local and explore government data about your community. Enter your city or zip code and get a list of facts. Click an individual item and be taken to a breakdown of the data. Finalist in Apps for America 2 contest.
Sightseeing via a World Video Map. Watch and map videos on Google Maps and Google Earth.
A history of places at which you checked in by foursquare is shown per a venue/month. It is also possible for the place to show by check-in history with heat maps.
iCommunity.TV is a collaborative broadcast network for local news, built with the intention to promote video as a media for citizen reporting.
Tracks micro-trends on twitter and brand user satisfaction. See metrics visualized using Google Visualization API.
LinkedIn search based on the LinkedIn JavaScript API.
QuickResu.me makes it super-simple to build a mobile resume linked to a QR code.
Automate downloads of your website traffic data from your Google Analytics account directly into Excel.

You can use this tool to calculate travel mileage for any number of trips, fetching information from Google Maps. Better yet, if you have trips entered in Google Calendar, you can fetch those events towards calculating mileage.
What's better, the book or the movie? The answer to an age old debate, using science.
Polaris is a cross platform desktop Google Analytics widget built using the Adobe AIR environment. With 8 standard reports it lets you keep your data always instantly available.
Map of restaurants in London, England.

Golfing enthusiasts can search for golf courses on a Virtual Earth map. Select a course and reserve tee times. This mashup combines data from Cybergolf, weatherforyou.com, and other sources to provide a comprehensive golf planning experience.
A combination of Hot or Not with funny dance videos.
Call My Wall allows Facebook users to call in and leave posts on their Facebook wall over the telephone.
Find maps of wineries found within each wine region.
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
We move your stuff from anything to anywhere.
Listmania cc is a collection of book lists and film lists. Listmania cc will improve the experience of browsing and reviewing all these lists.
Marketplacedigger.com is designed to help shoppers easily find, compare and buy anything online from marketplace merchants in less time.
Look for public Flickr photos with this tag-based search.
650+ data series from the Federal Reserve, US economic data in a navigable timeline with landmark events.
Rotten Tomatoes mashup with reviews for Comcast On-Demand Movies. When you don't know what to watch.

Kukunu is a new travel planning experience that simplifies the life of travellers around the world. Travelers can collaborate to create their itinerary then add transports, hotels, restaurants, activities and sights across the cities they plan to visit.
Mines the NPR news archives and publishes the backstory on Google trending topics to a Twitter Feed. Unique and compelling way to learn about hot trends in the news.

Are you a business owner looking to add an affiliate marketing feature to your e-commerce platform or want to start your own marketing network? Scaleo allows you to create a seamless customer experience that fits your brand perfectly. Get detailed statistics with 30+ data breakdowns and 50+ data points. Track, analyze, and optimize your campaigns in real-time, filter out fraud traffic and clicks, get automated alerts and easy affiliate payouts.
GetControl is a mobile payment application that provides businesses a way to measure and manage their online payments. This application is built for mobile, and uses Stripe API.
A Mashup of the events listed at the CyprusEvents.net with Google Maps.
make your own custom designs all with bacon .. and print it on anything from t-shirts to Phone cases
Makes it easy to review and delete/keep your old delicious bookmarks by showing the web page in a n iframe right next to some delete/keep buttons
See live photo uploads on FLickr.com as they happen.
A place to find your house in Spain.
Stay connected with your friends and contacts in your social networks on the go. Vodafone Update provides mobile access to Twitter, Facebook and MySpace, combined in a single UI.
vspotz is a hyper-local event search engine. Other available event search engines typically focus on major cities, however, vspotz is committed to having the most local search results.
Panoramic virtual tours presenting historical objects, landscapes, urban areas, hotels, restaurants, entertainment and sport centers etc. In Czech and English.
DD Smart is an initiative taken by Dunkin Donuts to provide customers with health and fitness data.

Audience Partners is an enterprise advertising management company that focuses on on healthcare, politics and public affairs. With the Audience Partners platform, customers will be able to micro-target different messages to different audience segments in order to increase engagement and return on their advertisement.
This mashup allows Box.net users to share files from within their Box accounts using Twitter.
See the weekly top 20 users from Flickr, as well as a selection of their highest-rated photos. Also options to see most favorites photos, most commented photos and most-used cameras.
Price Comparison Shopping searches the Web for the best deals and prices on the items you want and then brings them to you in one location.
itDuzzit enables developers and non-developers alike to build Twilio-powered voice and SMS applications without coding.

One Click Politics is an advocacy platform that allows campaign supporters to send messages to certain individuals. With One Click Politics, supporters are able to reach out to influential figures in the political arena that surround the candidates.

Web application provides tide prediction anywhere in the World Ocean for whole year. User can generate Tide Chart for his/her current location or search for a place. It is also possible to zoom-in to any minute in the Tide chart year and explore water level heights and extremes.
Allows Box.net users to send sharing links to content in their Box account through Gmail.
Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in Tokyo. Built using the ArtBeat API.
A collection of stuff to do with Flickr image manipulation, community based photo search engine and a system to print photos on shirts, mugs, and stickers.

Browse through list of all the rivers of the world categorized by continent, country. The rivers coordinates are mapped in Google maps, along with photos got from flickr. Provision is given to visit the details about the river in Wikipedia from the Map.
WordPress plugin that displays classroom projects that need funding on DonorsChoose. The plugin uses the content of your post to attempt to find related classroom projects.
Mashup of Google Maps and Rocky Mountain venture capital investments
ContractsForGeeks is an employment search tool that sources the indeed API to find job postings, then arranges them by city or state. It also includes and IT recruiter directory.

The Mars Explorer app (for Android devices) allows you to explore The Red Planet as a whole or through the eyes of one of three NASA rovers currently on the surface. Learn about each of the three rovers and the data they collect on the surface of Mars. Search through years worth of pictures the rovers have taken. Save and share your favorite pictures. Learn about how the rovers work and how they were built. Learn something new about Mars every day with the Daily Fact home screen widget. Get the latest weather details from the Rover Environmental Monitoring Station on board the Curiosity Rover.
Play a variation of the classic game Risk on a Google Map. Note: As of Dec 1, 2005 this has been shut down at the request of Hasbro Inc.
Find free on-street parking in NYC and Brooklyn. Other cities being added.
Allows Box.net users to view analytics about files they have shared through Box.
This is a browser extension that tells you when people remove you from all of their circles on Google+ (GooglePlus).

TripsQ turns airport checkins into various travel statistics. Foursquare can users sign in to tripsQ to visualize trips and travel itineraries. Provides users with detailed statistics on distance traveled, amount of CO² produced during each trip and other information.
Ask Vox is a community question and answer website, where users teach Vox, the website character, to answer questions with voice.
Mapping community site that lets users create and save maps consisting of waypoints and routes.

WebServicesPros provide automation between Americommerce shopping cart and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems through the use of AC API Web Services and different ERP and Accounting Softwares. The WebServicesPros Desktop application serves as an intermediary application to bridge the two systems as well as provide additional features to both ends when they are not present. The configurable and customized solutions allow several different shopping carts or even different cart providers to integrate while assisting the back office by making the process efficient and seamless from the accounting and fulfillment point of view.
mashfot is a one-page view about photography. You can find links, news and photos on this site.

SocketBot builds web applications using Node.js and Angluar JS. SocketBot also works with JavaScript, HTTP, and CSS for front-end development. A project they have developed is Stateship which allows users to find their national, state, and local government representatives.
Hockey equipment comparison shopping. Built using the shopping.com API.
TwitShop uses the real-time power of Twitter to search for personal sale, trade and auction items.
